agenticFrameworks.title: Top AI agentic frameworks & orchestration
agenticFrameworks.subtitle: LangChain / LangGraph, Apache Airflow, and enterprise workflow patterns we operationalise in AI Labs

items.title: LangChain & LangGraph
items.description: Composable LLM apps and stateful agent graphs — tool calling, human-in-the-loop interrupts, and durable checkpointing for long-horizon enterprise agents.

items.title: LangSmith & evaluation
items.description: Tracing, datasets, and eval loops so agent regressions are caught before promotion through int → test → acc → prod rings.

items.title: Apache Airflow 3
items.description: Durable DAGs for data prep, model refresh, RAG ingest, and scheduled agent jobs — Apache Airflow 3.x remains the enterprise backbone for batch and hybrid agent workflows.

items.title: Enterprise workflow patterns

codingAgents.title: Claude Code, Claude Cowork & ChatGPT for business teams

items.title: Claude Code

items.title: Claude Cowork

featured.title: AI Vibe Coding ਪਲੇਟਫਾਰਮ
